comparisons.throughput_unit: completed SE rounds per second; not accepted magic states
comparisons.attribution_note: Matched-control differences for the implemented scheduler. G compares the same slowest-total solo factory with the top solo; J compares the joint execution with that same solo. Signed phase effects are retained. J combines batching, placement, scheduling and shared-resource effects; it is not pure AOD contention and is not a physical bound.
